hero.fullText: Stop Guessing in the Gym. Get Coached 1-on-1.
hero.subtitle: Rethink Fitness is Mayur Vihar’s dedicated personal training facility. We eliminate generic workout routines by pairing you with a dedicated coach who programs every rep, monitors your lifting mechanics, and tracks your nutrition daily. Open floor access is also available for independent lifters.

features.description: Most commercial gyms sell you a membership and leave you on your own. We focus on structured coaching, form accuracy, and measurable progression.

items.title: Dedicated 1-on-1 Coaching
items.description: Every session is actively coached. Your trainer manages your sets, corrects joint angles, tracks weights, and ensures progressive overload every single week.

items.title: Independent Gym Floor Access
items.description: Prefer training solo? Access our biomechanically precise strength machines, free weight stations, and cardio zone without the usual overcrowding.

items.title: Small Group Training
items.description: High-energy, coach-led conditioning and functional group batches are launching soon for those who thrive in a team setting.

testimonials.description: Don't just take our word for it. Hear from the champions who grind here every day.

items.name: Karan M.
items.review: I wasted two years at commercial gyms doing random workouts with zero results. Within 4 months of 1-on-1 personal training at Rethink, I corrected my lower back posture during deadlifts and dropped 8 kg of fat while gaining visible muscle.

items.name: Sneha R.
items.review: The personal attention here is unmatched. My coach tracks every single kilo I lift and adjusts my diet week by week. It feels like a private athletic training studio right in Mayur Vihar.

items.name: Devansh P.
items.review: I use the regular gym access membership for my own strength training. The equipment quality is top tier, and unlike other gyms in the area, the floor isn’t overrun with people standing around.
